messages:
nina: Quick q — thinking of hauling my PS5 to the mezz for a mini-game night Thursday. anyone need a spare DualSense or want to bring a game? :video_game:

rod: I need a pad! mine died last week. will bring Smash (classic) if that's cool. :pray:

taylor: I can bring my copy of It Takes Two if we want co-op chaos. also down for some FIFA.

mike: Im bringing a portable router and a 10ft ethernet cable. projector HDMI does weird handshakes so adapters might be needed.

louise: Pizza or tacos poll? :pizza: :taco: vote below. Ill order whichever wins.

rod: :pizza: (hands down)

taylor: :taco: (+1 for tacos)

mike: :pizza: but also cake if someone wants to bring one. :birthday: 

nina: noted. also if anyone has a PS5 USB-C charge cable spare, please bring. mine looks like its at EOL.

louise: RSVP plz so I can count slices — drop a quick yes/no and what youll bring.

rod: rod - needs controller, bringing Smash

taylor: taylor - It Takes Two + FIFA

mike: mike - ethernet + router + HDMI adapter

nina: nina - PS5 + DualSense (1 spare) + USB-C cable (maybe)

louise: louise - food ordering and napkins :white_check_mark:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Mezz Game Night (PS5 + LAN)" Thu 19:00. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/2139998021

rod: anyone up for a quick 4-player rotation? or freeplay until 10pm?

taylor: rotation sounds fun. let's do short matches so everyone gets time.

mike: tiny PSA: mezz outlets are packed. bring power strips if you need extra ports.

nina: awesome, see y'all Thursday! :sparkles:
